```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

O = Path("../analysis/outputs")

def records(df, dcol, vcol):
    df = df[[dcol, vcol]].dropna().copy()
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol]).dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    df = df.rename(columns={dcol: "date", vcol: "value"}).sort_values("date")
    return df.to_dict(orient="records")

# ── Bank Lending (SLOOS, real) — C&I large net tightening, quarterly ──
sloos = pd.read_parquet(O / "sloos_dashboard.parquet")
panel_bank = records(sloos[sloos["loan_type"] == "C&I - Large"], "survey_date", "net_pct_tightening")

# ── Retail Credit (ABS-EE, real) — loan-weighted 30+ day auto delinquency, monthly ──
abs_ee = pd.read_parquet(O / "abs_ee_dashboard.parquet")
abs_ee["month"] = pd.to_datetime(abs_ee["filing_date"]).dt.to_period("M").dt.to_timestamp()
abs_ee["d30_cnt"] = abs_ee["d30_rate"] / 100 * abs_ee["loans_with_status"]
grp = abs_ee.groupby("month").agg(
    d30_cnt=("d30_cnt", "sum"), loans=("loans_with_status", "sum"), n=("d30_cnt", "size")
).reset_index()
grp["value"] = 100 * grp["d30_cnt"] / grp["loans"]
retail = grp[(grp["n"] >= 5) & (grp["month"] >= "2018-01-01")]
panel_retail = records(retail, "month", "value")

# ── Private Credit + AI (synthetic sample) ──
panel_private = records(pd.read_parquet(O / "private_credit_sample.parquet"), "date", "value")
panel_ai = records(pd.read_parquet(O / "ai_sample.parquet"), "date", "value")

ojs_define(panel_bank=panel_bank, panel_retail=panel_retail,
           panel_private=panel_private, panel_ai=panel_ai)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import { Plot } from "npm:@observablehq/plot"

mkSeries = recs => recs.map(d => ({date: new Date(d.date), value: +d.value}))

PANELS = [
  {desk: "Bank Lending", meta: "SLOOS · Quarterly", real: true,
   data: mkSeries(panel_bank), unit: "%", signed: true,
   label: "net C&I-large tightening",
   blurb: "How many banks tightened vs. eased lending standards — the Fed's quarterly loan-officer survey.",
   href: "/posts/2026-06-05-bank-lending-standards/", color: "#4A6FA5"},

  {desk: "Retail Credit", meta: "ABS-EE · Monthly", real: true,
   data: mkSeries(panel_retail), unit: "%", signed: false,
   label: "auto-loan 30+ day delinquency",
   blurb: "Delinquency on securitized auto loans, aggregated from SEC ABS-EE filings.",
   href: "#", color: "#B45309"},

  {desk: "Private Credit", meta: "Sample · Monthly", real: false,
   data: mkSeries(panel_private), unit: "%", signed: false,
   label: "direct-lending non-accrual rate",
   blurb: "Illustrative placeholder until BDC / private-credit data lands in the lake.",
   href: "#", color: "#7C6FB5"},

  {desk: "AI", meta: "Sample · Monthly", real: false,
   data: mkSeries(panel_ai), unit: "%", signed: false,
   label: "enterprise pilots with measurable ROI",
   blurb: "Illustrative — the slow climb out of the productivity J-curve trough.",
   href: "#", color: "#3A7D5E"}
]

fmt = (v, signed) => `${signed && v > 0 ? "+" : ""}${v.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 1})}`
fmtMonth = d => d.toLocaleString("en-US", {month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC"})

sparkline = (data, color) => Plot.plot({
  width: 300, height: 52, margin: 2, axis: null, x: {type: "utc"},
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(data, {x: "date", y: "value", fill: color, fillOpacity: 0.09}),
    Plot.lineY(data, {x: "date", y: "value", stroke: color, strokeWidth: 1.5}),
    Plot.dot([data[data.length - 1]], {x: "date", y: "value", r: 3, fill: color})
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="desk-grid">
  ${PANELS.map(p => {
    const last = p.data[p.data.length - 1];
    const prev = p.data[p.data.length - 2];
    const delta = last.value - prev.value;
    const arrow = delta > 0 ? "▲" : delta < 0 ? "▼" : "▬";
    return html`<article class="desk-panel">
      <div class="dp-kicker">${p.desk}<span class="dp-meta"> · ${p.meta}</span></div>
      <div class="dp-figure">${fmt(last.value, p.signed)}<span class="dp-unit">${p.unit}</span></div>
      <div class="dp-label">${p.label}</div>
      <div class="dp-spark">${sparkline(p.data, p.color)}</div>
      <div class="dp-delta">${arrow} ${fmt(delta, true)} vs prior · ${fmtMonth(last.date)}</div>
      <p class="dp-blurb">${p.blurb}</p>
      <div class="dp-foot">
        <a class="dp-open ${p.href === "#" ? "disabled" : ""}" href="${p.href}">${p.href === "#" ? "Timeline coming soon" : "Open desk →"}</a>
        ${p.real ? "" : html`<span class="dp-sample">Sample data</span>`}
      </div>
    </article>`;
  })}
</div>`
```
